criteria.evidence: docs/concurrency.md documents session lifecycle, snapshot visibility, write ordering, backpressure, checkpointing, and vector overlay semantics.
criteria.notes: Covered by WP01 contract documentation and retained in final acceptance evidence.

criteria.description: Read transactions acquire cheap generation snapshots instead of cloning every row at BEGIN.
criteria.evidence: tests/integration/snapshot_generation_acceptance.zig verifies generation handles and no retained row snapshot until a writer advances the generation.

criteria.description: Reader snapshots remain stable while later commits, checkpoints, and vector overlay updates occur.
criteria.evidence: tests/integration/concurrency_stress_acceptance.zig keeps many active readers stable while writers commit and checkpoint overlap is active.

criteria.description: Writer commits pass through one ordered commit sequencer.
criteria.evidence: tests/integration/commit_queue_acceptance.zig verifies monotonic commit sequence assignment through the commit queue.

criteria.description: The commit sequencer exposes bounded queue configuration and typed backpressure diagnostics.
criteria.evidence: tests/integration/commit_queue_acceptance.zig and tests/integration/concurrency_stress_acceptance.zig verify CommitQueueFull diagnostics and queue state preservation.

criteria.description: Rollback stays local and does not enqueue commit work or advance the sequence.
criteria.evidence: tests/integration/commit_queue_acceptance.zig verifies rollback leaves queue depth and commit sequence unchanged.

criteria.description: Checkpoint requests snapshot committed generations without mutating active reader snapshots.
criteria.evidence: tests/integration/checkpoint_vector_overlay_acceptance.zig verifies checkpoint tickets and active reader snapshot stability.

criteria.description: Checkpoint failures leave durable and in-memory committed state intact.
criteria.evidence: tests/integration/checkpoint_vector_overlay_acceptance.zig verifies failed checkpoint coordination leaves committed rows visible.

criteria.description: Vector writes are visible to exact SQL/vector scans through committed overlay state.
criteria.evidence: tests/integration/checkpoint_vector_overlay_acceptance.zig and tests/integration/concurrency_stress_acceptance.zig verify exact vector nearest queries after committed vector writes.

criteria.description: Vector overlay exposes drain hooks for a future background vector index worker.
criteria.evidence: src/vector/overlay.zig exposes drainReady/deinitDrained hooks, covered by checkpoint/vector overlay and stress integration tests.

criteria.description: Concurrency tests cover interleaved readers/writers, backpressure, rollback, checkpoint overlap, and vector overlay visibility.
Benchmark CLI reports separate Phase 6 metrics.
criteria.evidence: zig build run -- benchmark --rows 100 --vectors 32 --dimensions 8 --operations 25 reports snapshot_begin, queued_commit, concurrent_read_write, checkpoint_overlap, and vector_overlay_visibility.

criteria.description: Existing SQL, transaction, view, procedure, vector, MTR-lite, and persistence acceptance tests continue to pass.
criteria.evidence: zig build test passed after WP05 stress test and benchmark updates.
criteria.notes: Full root test step includes all current integration modules.

criteria.description: Implementation preserves embedded-first APIs and adds no server lifecycle concepts.
criteria.evidence: Phase 6 changes remain in embedded Database/session, test, docs, and CLI benchmark surfaces; no server, protocol, auth, or daemon lifecycle was introduced.

negative_invariants.description: Phase 6 must not introduce a server daemon, network protocol, auth, replication, plugin, or cloud lifecycle surface.
negative_invariants.evidence: Touched files are embedded executor/concurrency/test/docs/benchmark surfaces only.
